description: This Java class provides services for creating and updating manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events, specifically handling inventory event planning within the manufacturing module of the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: InventoryEventPlannedServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods to create or update manufacturing resource planning (MRP) events related to inventory planning.

methods.name: createMrpEvent
methods.description: Creates or updates an MRP event based on provided parameters, handling exceptions and returning service status.

methods.name: createOrUpdateMrpEvent
methods.description: Internal method to create a new MRP event or update an existing one by adding quantities and appending event names.
